items.headline: Average DAM (Southern proxy) MCP: Rs 4203.9/MWh
items.detail: Day-ahead market average clearing price for 2026-05-09 was Rs 4203.9/MWh across 96 15-min blocks (range Rs 1001.19-10000.0/MWh).

raw_values.region_note: Karnataka has no standalone day-ahead price; this uses the IEX Southern-region area clearing price as a proxy (see scope-note.md).

items.headline: Peak-hour (18:00-24:00) MCP premium: +103.5% vs daily avg
items.detail: Peak-hour average MCP was Rs 8556.07/MWh vs the day's overall average of Rs 4203.9/MWh, a +103.5% divergence.

items.headline: Wide intraday MCP spread: 214% of daily average
